title: Little Bear, In It Goes!
caption: A little story about helpful paws.
alt: A golden paper-collage bear in red shorts waves hello.

title: A bin! A bin!
action: Help Little Bear keep paws away from the bin
alt: Little Bear looks curiously at a white open round bin lined with a black trash bag, with both paws against its chest.

title: No digging
cue: Can you put your hands behind your back?
alt: Little Bear steps away from the white open bin and keeps both paws behind its back. A black bag is folded over the bin rim.

title: My snack is done
cue: Tap the wrapper. Let's find the bin!
action: Take the empty wrapper to the bin
alt: Little Bear holds its own empty blue snack wrapper.

title: Where does it go?
cue: Tap the bin. In it goes!
action: Drop the wrapper into the bin
alt: Little Bear releases a blue wrapper above the black-lined opening of a white round bin. The paw stays above the rim.

title: In it goes
action: Celebrate putting the wrapper in the bin
alt: The wrapper is inside the open white bin. Little Bear smiles with both empty paws resting against its own belly.

title: My used tissue
cue: Tap the tissue. In it goes!
action: Drop Little Bear's used tissue into the bin
alt: Little Bear drops its own white tissue into a white round bin lined with a black bag. Both paws stay outside the bin.

title: Wash those little paws
cue: Tap the bubbles. Rub, rub, rinse!
action: Help Little Bear wash its paws
feedback: Rub, rub, rinse! Clean little paws.
alt: Little Bear washes both paws with water and soap bubbles at a small blue sink.

title: Hooray, Little Bear!
cue: Tap a paw for a high five!
action: Give Little Bear a high five
alt: A happy golden bear with clean empty paws raises both arms in celebration.
